features.name: Disabled Log
features.description: Submits an Information event to a logger whose minimum level is Warning.

features.name: Simple Message
features.description: Delivers one literal Information message to an in-memory sink.

features.name: Structured Properties
features.description: Delivers one event with independently queryable OrderId and ElapsedMs properties.

features.name: Exception
features.description: Delivers one Error event retaining the original exception metadata.

features.name: Scope Or Context
features.description: Creates a temporary RequestId context and captures it on one event.

features.name: Template Rendering
features.description: Formats amount 12.5 and customer Ada through the logger template API.

features.name: Buffered Logging
features.description: Enqueues one event to a library-provided async or buffering wrapper and validates delivery after flush. Measures the cost of accepting the event; the remaining delivery work happens on a background thread.

features.name: Prepare Logger
features.description: Creates, verifies, and releases one Information-enabled logger with an in-memory sink.

features.name: Formatted Output
features.description: Formats one event synchronously into a bounded in-memory sink.
